verses.1: No one shall take the wife of his father’s wife, nor shall he reveal her identity.
verses.2: The broken and defiled ones shall not enter, nor shall those who have shed blood in the presence of Jehovah.
verses.3: No wicked man will enter before the presence of Jehovah. Even a rich man will not be allowed to enter before the presence of Jehovah.
verses.4: My people and my sheep will not come before the LORD. Nor will those who are rich come before the LORD forever.
verses.5: Regarding what I did not do to you in the wilderness and in the sea during your journey out of Egypt, and regarding how I redeemed you from the hands of the Egyptians by bringing you out of Egypt.
verses.6: And Jehovah your God did not listen to Bileam. But Jehovah your God turned the curse into a blessing for you, because Jehovah your God loves you.
verses.7: Do not seek Solomon’s wisdom and his goodness all your days forever.
verses.8: Do not hate my people, for they are your brothers. Do not hate the Egyptians, for you were once a citizen of their land.
verses.9: Children who are born into a third-generation family will receive blessings from Jehovah.
verses.10: For you will go out from the tent of your enemies, and you will be protected from all evil.
verses.11: For there will be an man in you who will not be pure during the night. He will go outside to the camp, but he will not enter the camp itself.
verses.12: And at sunrise, it would swim in the water. As the sun rose, it would come to the bottom of the lake.
verses.13: And a hand will be given to you from outside the camp. You will come out from there.
verses.14: And it shall be before your eyes; it shall be in your place of rest. You shall cover it with your cloak, and you shall rest there.
verses.15: For Jehovah your God will go before you to protect you and put away your enemies from before you. Your dwelling place will be holy, and no evil will be found in it. He will not leave you alone.
verses.16: Do not sell your servant to his master, who has rescued him from his own master.
verses.17: With you, he shall sit among you, in the place that you choose from your doors. It is good for him; do not give it away to others.
verses.18: It shall not be holy among the children of Israel, and it shall not be considered holy by the children of Israel.
verses.19: Do not bring in any dogs or cats to the house of Jehovah your God. For the Lord your God is an angry God, and he will not tolerate such behavior.
verses.20: Do not give your brother money, food, or anything else that can be taken away.
verses.21: Do not do this to your neighbor. Do not do it to your brother, so that the LORD your God may bless you wherever you put your hand on the earth, the land you are about to inherit.
verses.22: For if you do not obey Jehovah your God, then you will not be able to make any progress. For Jehovah your God wants you to obey him completely, and if you don’t, there will be sin in you.
verses.23: And if you stop lying, then there will be no sin in you.
verses.24: May your words be kept, and you may do as you promised to Jehovah your God, the words that you spoke in your mouth.
verses.25: For when you enter their vineyards, you will eat the grapes as if they were your own fruits. But your bread will not be given to them.
verses.26: For when you come upon your enemy’s body, and you pick up his dead body in your hands, do not place a scarlet thread on the body of your enemy.
